dataset.name: Notional Nordic Maritime Resilience Challenge — Health Events Register
dataset.fictionalisation_notice: All events, dates, asset states, causal descriptions and readiness values are fictional and intended only for hackathon prototyping. This file must be used together with assets.json and dependencies.json.

events.title: Corrective maintenance package open
events.operational_effect: Platform availability is limited pending completion of corrective work and post-maintenance checks.
events.recommended_initial_action: Prioritise maintenance-facility capacity and confirm availability of required repair items.

events.title: Reduced sensor confidence detected
events.operational_effect: Abstract surveillance contribution is reduced until calibration and verification are completed.
events.recommended_initial_action: Schedule a specialist inspection at the sensor maintenance site and assess alternate coverage.

events.title: Offshore gateway operating in degraded mode
events.operational_effect: Offshore connectivity redundancy is reduced; affected nodes may experience lower data availability and slower recovery from a second outage.
events.recommended_initial_action: Increase monitoring, validate fallback relay routes and plan a restoration visit.

events.title: Maintenance capacity constraint identified
events.operational_effect: Concurrent corrective-maintenance demand exceeds the synthetic facility planning capacity, increasing expected repair turnaround times.
events.recommended_initial_action: Reprioritise high-criticality work, defer lower-priority work and assess use of alternate maintenance capacity.

events.title: Contingency depot throughput restricted
events.operational_effect: Contingency supply transfers are delayed, reducing the effectiveness of alternate resupply routes.
events.recommended_initial_action: Reserve depot capacity for critical items and pre-position selected spares at forward support locations.

events.title: Planned underwater sensor maintenance window
events.operational_effect: The sensor will be temporarily unavailable during a planned maintenance window unless the activity is deferred.
events.recommended_initial_action: Check coverage and communications redundancy before authorising the maintenance window.

events.title: Backup site-service test overdue
events.operational_effect: The relay remains operational, but confidence in continuity during a site-service interruption is reduced.
events.recommended_initial_action: Complete the backup service validation and verify fallback routing for dependent assets.

events.title: Readiness reduced by pending supply confirmation
events.operational_effect: Platform remains available, but planned activity may be delayed if the synthetic supply confirmation is not received.
events.recommended_initial_action: Confirm issue and transport of critical support items; evaluate alternate depot route if delayed.

events.title: Forward support capacity reduced
events.operational_effect: The base remains available, but can accept fewer simultaneous support and response activities in the synthetic scenario.
events.recommended_initial_action: Preserve capacity for high-criticality support tasks and coordinate overflow with the primary support base.

events.title: Coastal distribution delay reported
events.operational_effect: Last-mile delivery time is increased for both support bases and the primary maintenance facility.
events.recommended_initial_action: Prioritise critical deliveries, use the logistics-support platform as an alternate route and update dependent task plans.
